Markets.title: Crude Oil Above $100: Can Saudi Arabia’s export disruption trigger a new global energy shock?
Markets.summary: Attacks on Saudi Arabia's East-West Pipeline have disrupted alternative export routes, pushing crude oil above $100 a barrel. Prolonged outages threaten to tighten global supplies and could drive Brent prices toward $115 to $125, increasing economic risks for oil importers like India.

Data & Insights.summary: Revenue Secretary Arvind Shrivastava stated that Indian states must increase their capital expenditure to 3% of their GSDP by FY32. This spending boost is necessary to support India's goal of becoming a developed economy by 2047.

Data & Insights.summary: Former finance commission chairman N.K. Singh stated that India must increase domestic savings and private capital to sustain a 7-8% economic growth rate. He also emphasized the need for improved capital allocation and stronger fiscal coordination between the central and state governments.
